[PATH:empirical] Electrophysiological studies in humans using transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to disrupt hypothesized temporal attractor networks (e.g., in prefrontal or temporal cortex) while measuring behavioral semantic regeneration in a lexical decision or synonym generation task with exogenous noise (e.g., auditory white noise bursts) applied 50 ms after TMS pulse. — Provides cross-domain validation in biological cognition, testing whether the hypothesized temporal precision and selectivity of attractor disruption abolishes semantic regeneration, or whether alternative mechanisms compensate.
